_README: Ingredient name -> the USDA FoodData Central food a person confirmed for it.
This file is the whole point of the two-step ingest. `ingest.mjs` searches FDC
and writes its suggestions to candidates.json; nothing is used until an fdcId
appears here, put there by someone who read the candidates and chose. A search
ranking is not evidence: 'Cheese' returns forty foods and the first and fourth
differ by a hundred calories an ounce.
`portions` is the escape hatch for a quantity USDA cannot weigh — a recipe
says '1 cup' and the food publishes no cup portion. Put the gram weight you
chose here, so it is a number with an author rather than one this script
Empty on purpose. Nobody has run the ingest against the live API yet, and a
seeded guess here would be exactly the unverified number this work removes.
